description: Variation of condition 3 (approved plans) to change the materials for the bifolding door from timber and glass to aluminium and glass in black/anthracite of planning permission 00721/69A/P1 dated 22/01/2020 for removal of windows and replacement with doors in flank elevation of the ground floor flat
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall begin before 22 January 2023.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted ( Cover Letter dated 06 February 2020;Unnumbered Location Plan; 200-PROP-02 Rev A: 16-02-20
Received: 17 February 2020) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - Prior to the further works for the development hereby approved, a boundary fence of 2 metres shall be erected between the application site and number 67 and shall be retained thereafter.
